#Text= mentary substance employed in dometie
#Text= economy.
#Text=By boiling isinglass in water, it
#Text= becomes dissolved, and furnishes a mild
#Text= tremulous jelly, which, when seasoned with
#Text= cream, bitter almonds, and sugar, is called
#Text= blanc-mange; and when seasoned with
#Text= lemon juice, sugar, and aromatics, forms
#Text= the basis of many delicacies for the table.
#Text=It is also employed in domestic use in the
#Text= clarification of various liquors ; and if small
#Text= shreds are thrown into boiling coffee, it
#Text= renders it clear in a few minutes.
